sources.evidence_notes: NEW FINDING this session: fetched futdb.app directly -- it is a pure marketing/pricing page ('Free to use for everyone', paid tiers by request volume, 'no way to get multiple player prices with one request and there will be no way in the future') with NO linked terms of service, license, or legal usage page anywhere on the site. A commercial API with no published terms cannot be classified GREEN or even a confident YELLOW -- there is no document granting the storage/derivative/redistribution rights a production product needs. Previously classified YELLOW (the most promising candidate); on closer inspection this session, downgraded to UNKNOWN pending a direct written agreement, since 'no terms published' is not the same as 'terms are favorable'.

sources.evidence_notes: NEW FINDING this session: a genuinely distinct-looking service from futdb.app, found while verifying FutDB's terms -- easy to confuse with futdb.app under casual research, which is itself a risk worth flagging. Its T&C explicitly permits use by 'individuals and companies' (more permissive language than FUTBIN/FUT.GG), but the T&C is a standard SaaS usage/payment/termination agreement -- it does not address storage, derivative-data creation, or redistribution rights, which is exactly what a production recommendation product needs confirmed. 'You may use our API' is not the same grant as 'you may store our data, derive new datasets from it, and serve those derived datasets to your own end users.'
